replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. Math makes me feel nervous because it reminds me of school struggles. My low openness and high neuroticism make new or complex topics stressful. Even simple problems can feel overwhelming sometimes.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA sounds advanced! I think it involves reducing data dimensions, but the math behind it is beyond me. Given my high neuroticism, I'd probably feel anxious trying to learn it. Maybe start with simpler stats first?
replies.According to you, how can LLMs be used t: LLMs could help by explaining concepts simply or providing practice problems. They might also offer personalized support for students who struggle, like me. But they shouldn't replace teachers—just assist them.
